title: 4096-bit (1024 x 4) Schottky TTL programmable read-only memory, three-state outputs

sources.document: TI The Bipolar Microcomputer Components Data Book, 3rd edition 1981: Series 24 and 28 Standard, Low-Power, Power-Down, Registered PROMs (June 1981)
sources.pages: pdf 37-48 (printed 2-13..2-24): product table 2-13, description 2-14, pin assignments 2-15, logic symbol 2-16, ratings 2-20, characteristics 2-24
sources.familyUsed: TBP24S41 (J, N), old type number SN74S476

pins.name: G1
pins.text: chip select 1 (drawn G1 with a bar): G1 and G2 both low enable the outputs; a high level at either turns them off

pins.name: G2
pins.text: chip select 2 (drawn G2 with a bar)

functions.text: Q0-Q3 give the 4-bit word addressed by A9..A0 while G1 and G2 are both low; high impedance otherwise.

state.write: Not in circuit: each PROM is supplied with a high logic level stored at each bit location; programming opens Ti-W links and is irreversible (p2-14).
state.contents: The contents are programmed for card 3207 and were not read; this file describes the blank part.

electrical.notes: Commercial (J, N): VCC 4.75..5.25 V, IOH -3.2 mA, IOL 16 mA; VIH 2 V, VIL 0.8 V, VIK -1.2 V; VOH 2.4 V min (3.1 typ), VOL 0.5 V max; IOZH 50 uA, IOZL -50 uA; II 1 mA at 5.5 V, IIH 25 uA, IIL -250 uA; IOS -20..-100 mA; ICC 95 typ, 140 max mA.

timing.conditions: access from chip select (enable time); CL 30 pF

unknown: The bit pattern stored in this card's PROM: card specific and not read.
notes: Card 3207 position 35F (G1 and G2 tied to GND on the card). The memory of the behaviour has no defined contents.
